headline_hook: Claude Code Ships Auto Mode as GPT-5.4 Solves Open Math

pick_of_the_day.thesis: GPT-5.4 solving an open Ramsey hypergraph problem isn't a benchmark flex — it's the first credible evidence that LLMs can contribute to mathematical frontiers, and it forces us to rethink what 'reasoning capability' actually means beyond leaderboard scores.

model_literacy.relevance: Anthropic's new research shows that how you configure the scaffolding around a coding agent — file access, tool permissions, context injection — can swing benchmark scores by more than the gap between top models. Today's Claude Code auto mode and Figma MCP stories are harness design decisions in practice.

items.title: Claude Code's New Auto Mode Lets the Agent Govern Its Own Permissions
items.angle: The permission UX was the last major friction point in agentic coding — auto mode eliminates it with guardrails, not by removing them
items.key_fact: 25,237 likes — the most-engaged Claude Code announcement this quarter

items.title: Gemini Flash-Lite Generates Entire Websites in Real Time as You Click
items.angle: Google's demo isn't about website quality — it's a showcase of what sub-second inference latency enables at the application layer
items.key_fact: Pages render on-navigate, not pre-built — each click triggers generation

items.title: Sakana AI Launches Free Japanese Chat Service on Post-Trained DeepSeek-V3.1
items.angle: A template for regional AI adaptation: take an open model, post-train to remove biases, ship a free product for a specific culture
items.key_fact: 5,311 likes — massive traction in the Japanese AI community

items.title: Moonshot's Kimi-K2.5 Hits 3.6M Downloads as Multimodal Agent Model
items.angle: The agent-capable architecture is drawing Claude comparisons — Chinese multimodal models are no longer a generation behind

items.title: Figma's MCP Server Gives Claude Code Full Design System Context
items.angle: The design-to-code handoff has been broken for a decade — MCP just made it a bidirectional conversation between Figma and your codebase
items.key_fact: Full design system tokens, components, and layout context flow into the coding agent

items.title: Claude Code Gets Cloud Cron Jobs with /schedule
items.angle: Claude shifts from on-demand tool to persistent background worker — schedule recurring tasks directly from terminal
items.key_fact: Cloud-based execution means jobs run even when your machine is off

items.title: Allen AI Releases MolmoWeb: Open-Source Browser Agent You Can Inspect and Run Locally
items.angle: A fully open alternative to proprietary computer-use agents — built on Molmo VLMs with inspectable code
items.key_fact: Built on Allen AI's Molmo vision-language models, runs locally

items.title: Anthropic: Harness Design Swings Coding Benchmarks More Than Model Choice
items.angle: Infrastructure configuration — not model selection — is the biggest lever in agentic coding performance. Most teams are optimizing the wrong variable.
items.key_fact: Harness config swings scores by several percentage points, sometimes exceeding the gap between top models

items.title: Running Massive MoE Models on Mac by Streaming Expert Weights from SSD
items.angle: You don't need the whole model in RAM — SSD streaming makes frontier-scale MoE inference practical on consumer hardware
items.key_fact: 3,104 likes — the local inference community is paying close attention

items.title: Epoch Confirms GPT-5.4 Pro Solved an Open Problem in Ramsey Hypergraph Theory
items.angle: This isn't a benchmark — it's independently verified mathematical discovery by an AI system, a qualitative shift from 'can solve hard problems' to 'can find new results'
items.key_fact: Independent confirmation by Epoch AI on a genuine open problem, not a curated challenge

items.title: Anthropic Economic Index: Experienced Users Iterate More, Automate Less, Achieve More
items.angle: Data shows the skill ceiling for AI tools is high and rising — expert users avoid full autonomy and attempt harder tasks
items.key_fact: Experienced users deliberately iterate more carefully rather than delegating fully

items.title: OpenReward: 330+ RL Environments Under One API with Autoscaled Compute
items.angle: A bid to become the standard infrastructure for RL agent training — 4.5M tasks, sandboxed, one API
items.key_fact: 4.5M+ unique tasks across 330+ environments with autoscaled sandboxed compute

items.title: LiteLLM Quarantined on PyPI After Supply Chain Compromise
items.angle: One of the most popular LLM proxy libraries was compromised — if it's in your dependency tree, audit now. Supply chain attacks on AI tooling are no longer hypothetical.
items.key_fact: Package quarantined on PyPI; compromised update was blocked but exposure window existed

items.title: The Agent Attack Surface: Your Filesystem Is the New Distributed Codebase
items.angle: AI agents with filesystem access can be poisoned through any file in context — the LiteLLM incident makes this attack vector concrete
items.key_fact: Skills, PDFs, config files — any document an agent reads can carry poisoned instructions

items.angle: Pairs with the MoE-on-SSD technique — Hypura intelligently schedules inference across RAM, SSD, and swap on Mac hardware
items.key_fact: Storage-tier awareness means the scheduler knows when to stream vs. cache expert weights
